english.note: Use this for the unexpectedly or surprisingly part of “curiously,” especially before an unexpected event or fact.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that happens unexpectedly or unusually.
This is the all-purpose choice for an outcome that is surprisingly contrary to expectations.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when an event or fact is surprisingly unexpected.
Use this when highlighting that the stated fact is surprising or hard to believe, but true.
Use this at the sentence level when highlighting that an event or fact is surprising or unexpected.
